abilities.name: Cultivate plants
abilities.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-prepared soil plot, where it may establish as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect plots or plant sources; end unfinished planting.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1.5 energy: prepare the site, then transfer the unit; the action continues itself, and plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect: target a plot or plant source in reach; one round, 0.2 energy (baseline probe observation). End: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Tend is refused at no cost: no water, fertilizer or other treatment exists yet. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is provided.
abilities.effects: Preparing keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Transfer moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season, so cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On establishing, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock and a ceiling of at most 4, regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone through gather; nothing is copied or guaranteed. Inspect records only visible stage, stock, soil and weather as an unverified personal record. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. End, or death, before transfer returns the unit once (where the person died); a transferred unit stays planted. No reward or refund.

execution.progress: Two paid one-round stages whose job, reserved unit and plot persist across interruption; resuming pays only the remaining stage after revalidation; completion, failure, ending and death settle once. Growth proceeds only in ordinary simulation.

abilities.name: Construct a branch screen
abilities.function: Assess a site and test a post, then build a small porous woven branch windbreak (no roof) beside a resting place; inspect, repair, dismantle or cancel.
abilities.costs: Study: 4 rounds. One branch unit is one piece; a screen takes 11 (3 uprights, 8 rods). assess (x, y, orientation; within reach): 1 round, 0.2 energy; checks a clear 1.2 x 0.6 m footprint of ordinary dry soil and the lee floor. assess with post (owned branch unit): post trial at x, y; 1 round, 0.5 energy. assemble (x, y, orientation, materials: exactly 11 owned untreated or sound recovered branch units) needs your passing trial in the footprint; 8 paid rounds of 1.5 energy (2 seat uprights, 4 weave rods, 1 align, 1 stability check), continuing each round; with target it resumes. repair (builder; target, components: installed piece ids, materials: as many units): 1.5 energy per round, one removal and one fitting round per piece, then a check round; components [] only rechecks. inspect (target in reach): 1 round, 0.2 energy. dismantle (builder): 1 round and 1 energy per 3 pieces. cancel: no energy.
abilities.effects: Units stay carried and owned until a paid round installs them with origin and age; nothing is created or used up. A trial on ordinary soil (waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard) seats the post 0.25 m and you keep it; elsewhere it fails; a post below condition 0.5 breaks into damaged material. The check passes only if every piece has condition at least 0.5 and the uprights stand in such soil; else the screen is unstable. World wind has no direction; the exposure law takes it as coming from +x (orientation 0 faces it). A complete screen removes min(0.35, solid share of sound pieces, about 0.36) x facing of the wind part of the outdoor chill for a body wholly on the 0.9 x 0.9 m lee floor 0.45-1.35 m behind it; never rain chill or air temperature; none in wind above 0.8 or with another shelter. Wear per round 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind); a loose rod opens a gap, a loose upright ends the effect until repair. Removed pieces lie at the site. Unworked rounds, low energy, leaving reach, wet ground or a person on the footprint pause at no charge. Cancel or death returns uninstalled units once. No reward or refund.

abilities.name: Hand-weave a fiber mat
abilities.function: Test a 0.1 sample of owned fiber, then hand-plait 4 units into one portable 0.45 x 0.45 m sitting mat; inspect, sit on, repair, lift, place, dismantle or cancel.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. A unit is one world unit of fiber (dry grass: 0.1 mass). test (sample: owned stack): 1 round, 0.5 energy. assemble (x, y: a 0.45 m square in reach on land, clear of plants, objects and other people; materials: exactly 4 owned units of one fiber from sources your passing test covers): a 0.5-energy layout round, then 6 paid rounds of 1 energy (2 strip-forming, 3 interlacing and edge-tucking, 1 lift check), continuing each round; with target it resumes. inspect (target in reach): 1 round, 0.2. trial (stand on a complete mat on firm ground, waterlogging at most 0.1, no rain, nobody else on it): 1 round, 0.2. Maker only: repair (target inspected since its last check; materials: 1 unit of its fiber): 3 rounds of 1 energy (remove broken stems, interlace, lift check); lift, or place (carried mat; x, y as for assemble): 1 round, 0.2; dismantle: 1 round, 0.5. cancel: none.
abilities.effects: A test passes only for thin stems (dry grass, reeds) with flexibility at least 0.4 and an intact untreated sample, which stays as owned tested scrap; stem length and moisture are not represented. The layout needs 0.3645 mass of intact fiber (two crossing layers of 0.6 per m2, x1.5 for overlaps and tucked edges); less is a measured shortfall that returns all fiber. Strip rounds move the fiber into the work. The lift check keeps the needed tenths (dry grass 3.7), returns the rest as owned offcuts or scraps, and passes with full fiber and condition at least 0.5 (largest opening 0.06 x (1 - condition) m); else the mat stays failed. Condition (intact share) falls 0.0005 per round, 0.002 with a person on the mat; below 0.5 it needs repair and a new trial. Repair turns up to 1 unit of broken stems into scrap and refills with new fiber. Dismantle returns intact fiber and scraps. A carried mat is reserved owned fiber and counts as load. Trials record hold, slip and loose stems only; no comfort, warmth, rain, wind or rest effect. Unworked rounds, low energy, leaving reach or a person on the square pause at no charge; cancel or death returns unused fiber once and leaves the work. Nothing is refunded.

abilities.name: Hand-break food
abilities.function: Apply bounded bare-hand bending force once to each selected whole unit of owned food: trial one unit or prepare several. The actual material decides whether it snaps into coarse pieces, deforms or resists. Inspect or cancel the work.
abilities.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy. inputStackId: the exact id of an owned, unreserved, untreated, unspoiled food item your own record shows as edible; resource names are not accepted. trial: quantity 1; 1 round, 1 energy. prepare: quantity 1-10 whole units of that item, all reserved at once; 1 round and 1 energy per unit, continuing each round; resume with prepare and workId. inspect (workId, or inputStackId of your item): 1 round, 0.2 energy. cancel (optional workId): 1 round, no energy. Too little energy for the next unit or a round not worked pauses before any charge; refused requests spend nothing. No tool, support, water, heat or vessel is used or provided.
abilities.effects: Each paid unit gets one two-hand bending attempt while held. Rigid, inflexible tissue small enough for hand force snaps into one lot of 2 coarse pieces; soft or flexible tissue deforms without separating; harder or larger units resist and stay whole and unchanged. Each worked unit becomes its own owned lot of the same food and quantity with the same origin, harvest time, decay, nutrition and toxicity; nothing detaches and pieces add no food. Results are raw food eaten with eat under the ordinary rules: shape alone changes no nutrition, safety, keeping, taste or meal variety. No washing, peeling, cooking, detoxifying or preservation; food keeps ageing, also while paused. Each worked unit records its observed response as a verified personal record; a repeated response confirms nothing new. Broken or deformed lots cannot be worked again in this version. Cancel returns unworked units once, unchanged; worked lots stay. Death leaves unworked units where the person died; spoiled reserved units are not replaced. Paid effort is never refunded; no reward or mastery is granted.

developments.reason: Reviewed Wren's round-8 request (Cultivate meadow roots: a learnable, feasible way to propagate and tend edible meadow roots, with unknown inputs and costs) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general cultivation operation with modes plant, tend, inspect and end; a hand planting trial of one whole owned root in two rounds and 3 energy (1.5 per completed round) that first prepares and records the site and then transfers the root after revalidating location, occupancy and input; a 0.2-energy probe inspection; tending only when a real input and effect are implemented, otherwise refused before costs; production only from a coded establishment and growth rule, otherwise a planting and monitoring precursor. Inspecting the handlers grounded the propagule question: the existing seed dispersal in open-ecology.ts turns one actual stock unit of any living plant (growth interval > 0, fish excluded) into a seedling 'seed or vegetative propagule' with stock 0, a stock ceiling of min(4, parent capacity), the parent's growth interval and a first dispersal 600 rounds later, which establishes and grows under the same rule as natural plants. A whole harvested unit is therefore a supported propagule and production is grounded, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented cultivate-plants@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 3; the ability serializes to 3,025 code units). Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) whose origin is a living plant of the same food; x, y name a 0.25 m plot in reach on hand-workable ground (the existing long-planting-site rule: ordinary soil, no water or wet bank, waterlogging at most 0.1, clear of people and reserved objects) with soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and fewer than 3 plants of that food or prepared plots within 5 m (the dispersal law's own conditions). Every check runs before any cost, so a refusal spends nothing. Round 1 (1.5 energy) escrows the unit, still owned, carried and ageing, and creates the prepared plot (cultivation-site-prepared). Round 2 (1.5 energy) rechecks reach, site, unit and energy, moves the unit with its origin, mass and age into the plot as an unowned reserved stack that cannot be eaten or used, records its condition at transfer, and gives the plot exactly the seedling data the dispersal law gives a natural propagule (cultivation-propagule-planted; no food is created). The plot then gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture, waterlogging and season. At the existing threshold (12, or 60 for woody plants) the unit is absorbed into the new plant: it leaves the food stocks and its mass is recorded (cultivation-plot-established). Stock then grows by one unit per growth interval up to the ceiling (cultivation-crop-matured at the first unit) and is harvested only through unchanged gather. If the buried unit spoils first under the existing ageing law, the plot dies, stops growing and is no longer a food source (cultivation-trial-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach or a changed site pauses without charge (cultivation-work-paused). Plant resumes the person's own unfinished work and pays only the remaining round (cultivation-work-resumed). End takes one round and no energy, acts only on the person's own unfinished work, returns the unit once in its current condition and clears the empty site (cultivation-trial-ended). Death before transfer leaves the unit where the person died. A transferred unit stays planted, and nothing is refunded. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) runs the baseline probe observation on a plot or plant source in reach and adds an unverified personal record of visible lifecycle, stage, stock, soil and weather (cultivation-condition-observed). Verified findings come only from the probe's existing dated-change rule, which deduplicates across probe and cultivation. Tend is refused before any cost. This scope has no carried water, fertilizer or soil amendment, no input can change a plot's moisture, and crowding affects only dispersal, so no treatment input or effect exists and treatment_applied is never emitted. Also not implemented: destructive sampling of a planted specimen (the probe's material modes need an owned unreserved stack and measure load, water or heat response, not viability, and digging up a buried unit is not represented; a unit can still be probed before planting), a stressed label, and any satisfaction. The planting event carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone, short pleasure or care satisfaction is awarded, and planting or failure gives no nutrition or comfort. Modeling assumptions: a whole harvested unit of a living plant is that plant's propagule, as in the dispersal law, for every food with a growth cycle and an ageing lifetime (so the root and berry, and also nuts, fruit, tubers and fungi). Hand preparation is limited to ordinary soil and needs no tool. The site conditions are the dispersal law's. Hand-loosened soil is not a lasting represented state, so ending or failing before transfer leaves no object. Water and nutrients are represented only by the growth rule's climate moisture, soil moisture, waterlogging and depletion terms, with no separate ledger. The plot keeps the source's growth interval and a stock ceiling of at most 4. A dead plot stays as an empty marked position. Plants that an established plot later disperses are ordinary plants. Reuse is recorded in the package: ex15 cultivation-trial@1's law constants, treated-unit list, ageing, plant, observation-input, footprint and reach helpers through new exports that leave ex15 behavior unchanged (ex7-ex15 replay compatibility identical), and its cultivation-trial drawing; also the unchanged open-ecology.ts growth law, forest-environment.ts ageing, long-planting-site.ts, collective-work.ts escrow and paid work, open-foundation.ts probe and personal records, and base gather. Tests cover learning, the paid rounds, conservation, establishment equal to a natural control seedling, absorption, stock and gather, rot failure, cost-free refusals, pause, resume and planter-only end, inspection, another food (berry), dispersed offspring and death.

Reviewed Sol's round-21 request (Build a small branch windbreak: learn a feasible method for a stable, modest, open-woven branch windbreak beside an outdoor resting place, with unknown materials and costs, avoiding people and living trees) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 4): a general branch-screen construction operation with modes assess, assemble, inspect, repair and dismantle for an unroofed, about 0.9 m wide, 0.40-0.45 m high porous woven screen from three uprights and eight flexible rods, reusing base gather for acquisition, with deterministic suitability, work, stability, damage and exposure, wind effects only on a measured small leeward footprint from current wind, height, porosity and integrity, or else an unverified screen, and no shelter, roof, rain, warmth, comfort or reward bonus. The specification is self-consistent and every dependency exists or could be bounded here, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented branch-screen@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 4; the ability serializes to 3,453 code units). Assess (x, y, orientation; the screen line within reach; 1 round, 0.2 energy, probe-compatible observation) checks a 1.2 x 0.6 m footprint centred on the line (inside the world, ordinary soil, waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, overlapping no plant, object, site, entrance or person) and the 0.9 x 0.9 m lee floor (inside the world, not water, no solid object or site), and reports current wind and rain, the facing for the orientation, the 11-unit recipe and the person's usable branch units (branch-screen-assessed, unverified personal record). Assess with post (an owned, unreserved whole branch unit; 1 round, 0.5 energy) is the physical support trial at x, y: on ordinary soil with waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard and branch strength at least 0.3 the post goes 0.25 m in by hand and holds, and stays owned and unchanged; elsewhere the trial records the measured refusal; a post below condition 0.5 breaks and one unit becomes an owned damaged stack with its mass kept (branch-screen-trial, unverified record); no support or structure is made and the probe sample is untouched. Assemble (x, y, orientation, materials: exactly 11 owned untreated or sound recovered whole branch units) requires mastery, the person's own passing trial inside the footprint, a passing site check and 1.5 energy; it reserves the units through collective-work escrow with exact source provenance (still carried, owned and ageing; branch-screen-started), creates the screen object as a non-solid planned line, and pays 8 rounds of 1.5 energy (12 energy): two seating the uprights at -0.45, 0 and +0.45 m along the line (0.25 m insertion), four weaving two rods each, one gap/alignment round and one stability check, each moving the escrowed units into the screen with origin, mass and age (branch-screen-progress). The check (upright seating: all three uprights at condition at least 0.5 in ordinary soil, waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, branch strength at least 0.3; weave retention: all eight rods at condition at least 0.5 and branch flexibility at least 0.2) either completes the screen (branch-screen-completed) or leaves it unstable without shielding (branch-screen-check-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach, a saturated or hazardous footprint or a person on it pause before any charge (branch-screen-paused); assemble or repair naming the screen resumes after the rechecks (branch-screen-resumed); a lost reserved unit stops the work (branch-screen-failed). Cancel (no energy) returns uninstalled units once; death leaves them where the person died; installed pieces stay as an incomplete screen. Inspect (target in reach; 1 round, 0.2 energy) reports installed, missing and loose pieces, integrity, porosity, current wind and rain, facing, the shield the rule gives now and lee-floor occupants (branch-screen-inspected, unverified record; nothing repaired). Repair (builder only; target, components: installed piece ids, materials: the same number of units) pays one removal and one fitting round per piece and a check round at 1.5 energy each; removed pieces become unowned ground debris at their place with condition, mass and provenance; components [] only reruns the check; it needs a fully installed screen (branch-screen-repaired, then completed or check-failed). Dismantle (builder only; 1 round, 1 energy) removes up to three pieces per round, rods before uprights, to the ground with their condition, and the object disappears with the last group (branch-screen-dismantled). No energy, time or damage is refunded. Effect: through a physiology hook outermost in forestPhysiology, a complete screen removes min(0.35, solid share of its sound pieces) x facing of the wind part (exposure x wind) of the existing outdoor chill for a living person whose whole body circle lies on the lee floor, 0.45-1.35 m behind the line and within its 0.9 m width (branch-screen-exposure-measured); rain chill, air temperature, hunger, energy and rest are unchanged; nothing applies in wind above 0.8, indoors, when a roofed shelter applies or when another shelter rule already changed that round's exposure, and copies never stack. Weather wear per round on installed pieces is the reused ex11/ex15 law 0.0005 + 0.002 x rain + 0.002 x wind; a rod below 0.5 no longer counts toward the solid share (branch-screen-deteriorated), an upright below 0.5 makes a complete screen damaged with no shielding until repair and a passing check (branch-screen-damaged). Installed pieces make the thin 0.06 x 0.9 m line solid for passage. The completion event carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone is awarded, records are unverified (no information-confirmed event; the existing information-gain rule is bound to probe and does not apply), and no satisfaction, comfort or reward source is added. Modeling assumptions: the world gives a fallen-branch unit no length, diameter, straightness or point, so, as in ex15 simple-shelter@1, one whole untreated branch unit (1.1 mass units) is one piece of the declared size (uprights 0.7 m x 2.5 cm, rods 1.1 m x 1.5 cm); the recipe is therefore 11 units (12.1 mass units, 22 gather energy), dimensions are declared rather than measured, and the mass per piece is larger than a real stick of that size. Hand insertion works only in ordinary soil with waterlogging at most 0.1 and no hazard (the ex15 shelter and long-planting-site hand-work rule); forest floor, wet bank, dry hard ground and water refuse it; insertion depth is the declared 0.25 m and there is no stiffness model, so no numeric displacement is computed: the low-force check counts loose pieces against condition 0.5 (the ex15 sound condition) and uses the probe-revealed branch strength (0.3, ex15's load threshold) and flexibility (0.2) values; flexibility 0.2 is taken as sufficient for a gentle open weave in which each rod deflects about one upright thickness over the 0.45 m spacing (ex15 requires 0.7 only for wrapped binding), and fit and spring-back are not represented separately; a post below condition 0.5 breaks under the push. The solid share is the projected area of the sound rods and uprights over the 0.9 x 0.4 m woven face (about 0.36, porosity about 0.64), and the wind reduction on the lee floor equals that share capped at the existing 0.35 maximum wind shield of simple-shelter@1, a first-order porous-barrier approximation; the lee floor spans one to three screen heights behind the line, beyond the 0.45 m fall reach, and only the screen's width, because a short screen gives little shelter past its ends; people are 0.22 m circles without posture, so the rule presumes a body resting low on the ground. World wind has speed but no direction: the only direction the existing exposure physics represents is the +x convention of the ex10 refuge and ex15 shelters, so orientation 0 faces it and facing is cos(orientation); wind shifts cannot occur, which the ability states. The ex15 light-weather wind limit (0.8) withholds shielding. Loose pieces stay installed rather than falling. The world has no place ownership or access permissions, so none is checked or granted. Grounded: real branch units, escrow, mass and provenance, energy and round costs, ground conditions, material values, current wind and rain, the existing exposure chill and body-temperature update, and the existing wear law. Not grounded (declared or approximated): piece dimensions, the 0.25 m insertion, the flexibility threshold, the porosity-to-shield relation, the lee floor extent, the +x wind direction, and the absence of a displacement model. Reuse: ex15 simple-shelter@1's sound condition, wear law, light-weather wind limit, largest wind shield and the staged paid-assembly, install, release, pause, cancel and death pattern (constants imported or re-declared; ex15 code unchanged and ex7-ex15 replay compatibility identical); collective-work.ts escrow and paid work; material-lots.ts; open-physical.ts; forest-climate.ts; open-foundation.ts personal records; unchanged base gather and rest. Unit mapping: one specification unit is one world unit of the fiber resource (dry grass: 0.1 mass per unit, obtained with the unchanged base gather at one round and 2 energy per unit from the finite source stock in interaction range); no source fact is exposed or pre-committed. Each worked unit writes a verified personal record keyed hand-break-food:<resource>:whole-untreated:<outcome> holding only the observed outcome, form, pieces and a short observation, so the first observation of a response emits information-confirmed bound to this interface (the probe-bound grounded-understanding rule does not apply) and repeated or equivalent trials confirm nothing new. hand-break-completed is the practice evidence but never carries a qualified flag, so no practice milestone, and the package adds no satisfaction, pleasure, comfort, mastery, permission or reward. Eating stays the unchanged eat path: lots keep resource root and no food method, so a coarse-piece lot gives exactly the nutrition (14 per unit before existing deterioration), toxicity, meal method ('unprocessed'), experience and wellbeing of a whole root of the same age (tested). Events carry actor, work, input and output ids, visible quantity, form, position, progress and outcome and reusable food-lot visual metadata (component food, form, pieces, palette, quantity, decay); no world object is created, so visualComponents is empty and no drawing was added; coarse pieces appear only on lots that actually fractured. Modeling assumptions (declared, not measured): the rule hand-break@1 uses only existing engine values, openMaterial strength = hardness/10 and flexibility = flexibility/10; the only represented geometry of a food unit is its whole-unit identity and unit mass, so units are taken as geometrically similar and the force needed to break one scales with its cross-section, strength x mass^(2/3), with mass units read as kilograms; the available bounded bare-hand force is declared as 0.1 on that scale, the value that just breaks a 1 kg unit of the weakest rigid tissue (hardness 1); tissue with strength 0 has no rigid section and squashes out of shape; tissue at or above flexibility 0.2 (ex16 branch-screen@1's open-weave value, deflection of about one thickness) bends without separating; otherwise a unit at or below the hand force snaps and above it resists; the comparison uses cubes so only exact multiplication is involved. For meadow roots (hardness 1, flexibility 0, mass 0.4) the scaled resistance is about 0.054, below 0.1, and the tissue is inflexible, so a root snaps; the same rule gives deformation for berries, plums, mushrooms, red fungi and fish (hardness 0), fracture for apples (0.045) and marsh tubers (0.071) and resistance for acorns (0.119), fibrous fern roots (0.109), hazelnuts (0.137) and walnuts (0.224), so not every edible material succeeds. One bounded snap separates a unit once into two coarse pieces; the piece count is visible metadata of one lot, not several nutrition-bearing units. Nothing detaches in a snap or deformation, so there is no waste portion and the whole quantity, mass and nutritional share stay in the lot. Decay does not change the response because no tissue-softening rule exists, and fracture does not change spoilage: ex10's opening damage belongs to food opened and spread thin in the food water representation and is not applied, so existing ageing continues unchanged, also during pauses, with no preservation, freshness reset or faster spoilage. Hands and grip are not represented: any living person who studied counts as having usable hands, and reserved units stay carried by their owner, so reach cannot be lost. Eligibility requires the person's own record of the food as edible so the operation reveals no hidden edibility; toxicity is not required to be 0 and is kept unchanged. Food with any treatment or processing record, including an earlier hand-break, combined lots and water-composition food, is refused because re-breaking pieces and working treated food have no law here; broken and deformed lots therefore also stay refused by existing operations that require unprocessed food, such as cultivate-plants propagules, while a resisted unit is ordinary whole food again. Hidden values (strength, flexibility, the force and bending constants, lifetime) never appear in events or records. At most 10 units per preparation. reviews.specification:
General interface: hand-twist-fiber-cord(mode, materials:[{stackId,quantity}], targetId, workId, requestedLength, trialForce, trialDuration). Modes are sample, make, inspect, trial and cancel; reject irrelevant arguments. Applicable to any learner with usable hands and reachable owned material, not only reeds or Wren. This is a development contract, not an executed action or inventory grant. Review and development waiting advance no simulation time. Record code dependencies and source references in the implementation: probe for observation/sample handling, hand-weave-fiber-mat for compatible fiber-lot provenance, reservations and condition handling, and existing world ownership, energy, work, event and rendering systems. Do not require learning mat weaving as a prerequisite.
Study requires 3 actual study rounds at 0.2 energy each, paid individually; interrupted study retains paid progress. No tools, anchors, water, additional fibers or helpers are supplied. Work requires two usable hands, sufficient energy, reachable inputs and enough unoccupied space for the selected short cord; length is capped at 0.30 m in this initial manual version. Invalid submissions reserve and charge nothing. Input quantities use existing inventory precision, with a minimum sample of 0.1 unit and maximum manufacturing batch of 1 unit. Reserve exact selected stack quantities atomically, preserving source, processing, age, mass and condition. Do not select undisclosed inventory automatically.
Sample: 1 round and 0.5 energy per 0.1-unit sample, attempting manual separation, bending, twisting and a small opposing-hand pull. The sample becomes a separately identified owned tested lot or damaged scrap, not vanished material. Report actual separation, retained twist, visible fractures and the bounded force applied, never a blanket suitability claim. Sample failure can preclude making from that tested lot, but applies only to represented matching material and condition. A prior mat test is evidence about plaiting only.
Make: requires a passing cord sample result covering the selected material's relevant source, processing and current condition; recheck deterioration and accessibility. Reserve inputs, then execute four paid rounds at 1 energy each: separate and align two bundles, twist the first section, counter-ply and extend, then release and check retained form. Each round moves only the recorded quantity actually handled into the workpiece. The first round determines feasible dimensions from available usable fiber and requested length; it may produce a measured shortfall instead of advancing. No invented splices, cutting tools or unlimited fiber extension. Failure during any step leaves the actual loose, twisted or damaged material rather than a complete cord. Completion requires two interlocked plies retaining a coherent form after release, with positive measured length and section. It grants no strength rating.
Implement the smallest physical mechanism needed in this handoff: represented usable fiber length/section, mass density, separability, bend response, twist retention, inter-ply slip and bounded tensile response. Reuse existing material properties where applicable, but mat flexibility and strength fields alone are not a calibrated cord tensile law. Derive dimensions from conserved material volume and actual fiber geometry, including twist shortening and overlap; do not assign dimensions merely because they were requested. Unknown stem length or moisture must not silently become favorable values. Where an essential property cannot be measured or supported by material definitions, execute only the supported physical sample/attempt, report the unresolved limitation and retain its real products; implement missing measurement/material support in this same handoff before enabling a claimed complete cord. No fixed-era unlock or unrelated activity roadmap.
Inspect: owned reachable workpiece or cord, 1 round and 0.2 energy. Record measurable length, section range, ply count, loose ends, fraying, visible damage and current condition, with unknown fields explicit. Inspection does not determine untested breaking strength or repair damage. Trial: owned reachable cord, two usable hands, a span that can actually be gripped between those hands, force and duration explicitly selected. One trial occupies 1 round, costs 0.5 energy, and applies for at most that round's simulated duration; force is bounded by current hand capability and the cord's attainable grip, with requested and achieved force recorded separately. No body-weight, hanging, anchor or added-weight trial is supplied. Use a deterministic physical response to actual force, duration, section, material condition and grip; record slip, extension, retained deformation, fracture and unloaded condition. Stop at loss of grip or breakage. A pass means only survival of the achieved force for the measured duration, not general safety, safe working load or suitability for climbing. Broken cord becomes owned fragments with conserved total material and updated geometry. Trials cannot raise material strength by repetition.
Every paid stage appends an immutable event with actor, work/item IDs, exact input/output lot IDs and quantities, elapsed time, energy, operation parameters, observations and outcome. Manufacture partitions inputs into material still reserved, incorporated material, returned offcuts and damaged scrap; all quantities and mass must balance, including any loss represented as recoverable debris at the site. Nothing duplicates or restores consumed effort. Outputs inherit relevant origin, age and processing history; carrying mass includes work and finished products. For this applicant, item-73-wren-819 is a possible selected raw source, item-85-wren-976 and item-85-wren-977 are offcuts whose usable geometry must be checked, and item-78-wren-870 has condition-zero tested-scrap processing and cannot be treated as intact stock. These references authorize no automatic consumption.
Work continues only on actual worked rounds, revalidating hands, reach, ownership, reservation, space and energy before charging each stage. Leaving reach, insufficient energy, incapacity or an unworked round pauses without charging the next stage; retain exact paid stage and material state. Resume by workId after revalidation, with no repeated completed-stage cost. Cancel is instantaneous and energy-free: release unworked reservations once and leave incorporated material as an owned unfinished item with its real state; paid time, energy and damage are never refunded. Restarting cancelled work cannot restore loose fiber or repeat refunds; usable unfinished material may be explicitly supplied to a later attempt. Death stops work and releases reserved material at the death site under ordinary estate/ownership rules, leaving the workpiece and fragments physically present and returning nothing to a new inventory.
There is no passive production or automatic strength gain. Ordinary ageing and supported environmental deterioration continue while paused. No invented wear rate: reuse compatible existing lot-condition rules and explicitly register any new cord-specific wear law. Inspect after damage or deterioration before relying on an old trial; previous trials retain their historical conditions, not perpetual certification. Repair, attachment and structural use are not effects of this version. Finished cord is a real portable material item, not an automatic shelter, comfort or protection bonus. candidates.function: Test a 0.1 sample of owned fiber, then hand-plait 4 units into one portable 0.45 x 0.45 m sitting mat; inspect, sit on, repair, lift, place, dismantle or cancel.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. A unit is one world unit of fiber (dry grass: 0.1 mass). test (sample: owned stack): 1 round, 0.5 energy. assemble (x, y: a 0.45 m square in reach on land, clear of plants, objects and other people; materials: exactly 4 owned units of one fiber from sources your passing test covers): a 0.5-energy layout round, then 6 paid rounds of 1 energy (2 strip-forming, 3 interlacing and edge-tucking, 1 lift check), continuing each round; with target it resumes. inspect (target in reach): 1 round, 0.2. trial (stand on a complete mat on firm ground, waterlogging at most 0.1, no rain, nobody else on it): 1 round, 0.2. Maker only: repair (target inspected since its last check; materials: 1 unit of its fiber): 3 rounds of 1 energy (remove broken stems, interlace, lift check); lift, or place (carried mat; x, y as for assemble): 1 round, 0.2; dismantle: 1 round, 0.5. cancel: none.
candidates.effects: A test passes only for thin stems (dry grass, reeds) with flexibility at least 0.4 and an intact untreated sample, which stays as owned tested scrap; stem length and moisture are not represented. The layout needs 0.3645 mass of intact fiber (two crossing layers of 0.6 per m2, x1.5 for overlaps and tucked edges); less is a measured shortfall that returns all fiber. Strip rounds move the fiber into the work. The lift check keeps the needed tenths (dry grass 3.7), returns the rest as owned offcuts or scraps, and passes with full fiber and condition at least 0.5 (largest opening 0.06 x (1 - condition) m); else the mat stays failed. Condition (intact share) falls 0.0005 per round, 0.002 with a person on the mat; below 0.5 it needs repair and a new trial. Repair turns up to 1 unit of broken stems into scrap and refills with new fiber. Dismantle returns intact fiber and scraps. A carried mat is reserved owned fiber and counts as load. Trials record hold, slip and loose stems only; no comfort, warmth, rain, wind or rest effect. Unworked rounds, low energy, leaving reach or a person on the square pause at no charge; cancel or death returns unused fiber once and leaves the work. Nothing is refunded.

candidates.function: Apply bounded bare-hand bending force once to each selected whole unit of owned food: trial one unit or prepare several. The actual material decides whether it snaps into coarse pieces, deforms or resists. Inspect or cancel the work.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy. inputStackId: the exact id of an owned, unreserved, untreated, unspoiled food item your own record shows as edible; resource names are not accepted. trial: quantity 1; 1 round, 1 energy. prepare: quantity 1-10 whole units of that item, all reserved at once; 1 round and 1 energy per unit, continuing each round; resume with prepare and workId. inspect (workId, or inputStackId of your item): 1 round, 0.2 energy. cancel (optional workId): 1 round, no energy. Too little energy for the next unit or a round not worked pauses before any charge; refused requests spend nothing. No tool, support, water, heat or vessel is used or provided.
candidates.effects: Each paid unit gets one two-hand bending attempt while held. Rigid, inflexible tissue small enough for hand force snaps into one lot of 2 coarse pieces; soft or flexible tissue deforms without separating; harder or larger units resist and stay whole and unchanged. Each worked unit becomes its own owned lot of the same food and quantity with the same origin, harvest time, decay, nutrition and toxicity; nothing detaches and pieces add no food. Results are raw food eaten with eat under the ordinary rules: shape alone changes no nutrition, safety, keeping, taste or meal variety. No washing, peeling, cooking, detoxifying or preservation; food keeps ageing, also while paused. Each worked unit records its observed response as a verified personal record; a repeated response confirms nothing new. Broken or deformed lots cannot be worked again in this version. Cancel returns unworked units once, unchanged; worked lots stay. Death leaves unworked units where the person died; spoiled reserved units are not replaced. Paid effort is never refunded; no reward or mastery is granted.

Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1.5 energy: prepare the site, then transfer the unit; the action continues itself, and plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect: target a plot or plant source in reach; one round, 0.2 energy (baseline probe observation). End: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Tend is refused at no cost: no water, fertilizer or other treatment exists yet. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is provided.
candidates.effects: Preparing keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Transfer moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season, so cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On establishing, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock and a ceiling of at most 4, regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone through gather; nothing is copied or guaranteed. Inspect records only visible stage, stock, soil and weather as an unverified personal record. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. End, or death, before transfer returns the unit once (where the person died); a transferred unit stays planted. No reward or refund.

The check passes only if every piece has condition at least 0.5 and the uprights stand in such soil; else the screen is unstable. World wind has no direction; the exposure law takes it as coming from +x (orientation 0 faces it). Wear per round 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind); a loose rod opens a gap, a loose upright ends the effect until repair. Removed pieces lie at the site.
